meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning: a hostile team cross-critiques a plan before it is formalized. Use when planning needs maximum rigor or the user asks for a hyperplan / adversarial or cross-critique plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让关键计划在敲定前先经受多方挑刺与交叉质疑,变得更扎实
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你制定关键计划时希望有人从对立角度帮你查漏补缺,而不是只收获附和。
copy.tagline_en: Toughen up your plan by running it past a hostile review team before you commit.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you own important plans and want them to survive hostile scrutiny before being locked in.

howto.what: Claude 会先播报「HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!」,再带领 5 个互相激烈攻击的成员交叉批判,只留下扛住攻击的洞见,最后交给专门的 planner 写成计划。
howto.when: 当规划需要最高严谨度,或你要求「hyperplan」「对抗式计划」「交叉批判计划」时触发。前提是 omo-senpi 团队工具可用,且当前是顶层 lead 会话。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 批判这份迁移方案,再出计划
say.note: 会先启动对抗团队交叉批判

say.text: 用交叉批判的方式评审这个架构设计,然后写成计划
say.note: 只保留扛住攻击的结论

say.text: 对这份 API 重构方案开一场 hyperplan
say.note: 5 名成员互相攻击彼此的结论

howto.what_en: Claude first announces “HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!”, then leads 5 mutually hostile members who cross-critique, keeps only the defensible insights, and hands them to a dedicated planner to formalize.
howto.when_en: Triggers when planning needs maximum rigor, or you ask for a hyperplan, adversarial, or cross-critique plan. Requires the omo-senpi team tools and a top-level lead session.

say_en.text: Run a hyperplan on this migration plan, then produce the plan
Cross-critique this architecture design, then formalize it
Open a hyperplan on this API refactor proposal
